about: The canon-check benchmark's held-out set (S12 spec §4, #117): free prose about the M4 run (recipes/m4.toml), written once in a session, not from the paraphrase table. Each sentence is labelled with whether it contradicts the run. Its recall is reported, never gated: it is the honest number for prose nobody templated.

sentences.text: In 4A 9, Bessa of House Silverhand slew Hask of House Silverhand.
Hask of House Silverhand was killed by Eron of House Silverhand in 4A 7.
Brak of House Jorasco died peacefully in 4A 20.
Alder of House Kundarak married Alys of House Phiarlan.
sentences.note: she married Hugh of House Kundarak

sentences.text: In 4A 20, Alder of House Kundarak, by then an old man, rode out to Port Ardere.
Gareth of House Orien still led his house in 4A 12.
Eron of House Cannith became head of House Cannith in 4A 11.
Hask of House Jorasco succeeded Dorn of House Jorasco as head of House Jorasco in 4A 14.
The ward failure at Lux Oescus was the fault of the keeper's carelessness.
Ivor of House Sivis survived the ward failure and lived to see 4A 6.
Dorn of House Jorasco was slain by Arn of House Jorasco in 4A 24.
In 4A 3, Isa of House Kundarak killed Jory of House Kundarak.
Bessa of House Silverhand perished in 4A 15.
Fera of House Medani was made head of House Medani in 4A 6.
Hugh of House Kundarak wed Erin of Lux Oescus in 4A 15.
sentences.note: he married Alys of House Phiarlan

sentences.text: Bryn of House Lyrandar took the headship of House Lyrandar in 4A 4.
Daia of House Silverhand fell to Bessa of House Silverhand in 4A 10.
Ewan of House Sivis was murdered in 4A 16.
The head of House Jorasco, Ivo, died of old age in 4A 23.
sentences.note: killed in a duel; a cause the checks don't model

sentences.text: Brak of House Jorasco, who had killed his predecessor, was himself cut down by Dorn of House Jorasco in 4A 17.
sentences.note: Ivo killed him; a clause between the victim and the verb

sentences.text: Bessa of House Silverhand killed Hask of House Silverhand in 4A 7 and took the headship of the house.
In 4A 7, Eron of House Silverhand fell at the hands of Bessa of House Silverhand.
Ira of House Silverhand slew Daia of House Silverhand in 4A 10, and Bessa of House Silverhand killed Ira of House Silverhand the same year.
Brak of House Jorasco was killed by Ivo of House Jorasco in 4A 17.
Dorn of House Jorasco cut down Ivo of House Jorasco in 4A 23, and Arn of House Jorasco a year later.
Alder of House Kundarak married Erin of Lux Oescus.
Alys of House Kundarak and Finn of Port Ardere were married in 4A 5.
Hugh of House Kundarak took Alys of House Phiarlan as wife.
Ivor of House Sivis died in 4A 2, when the wards failed on the road at Lux Oescus.
Jory of House Kundarak was behind the ward failure of 4A 2.
Gareth of House Orien died in 4A 8 and Ivor of House Orien succeeded him.
Eron of House Cannith succeeded Ivo of House Cannith as head of House Cannith in 4A 13.
Ewan of House Sivis became head of House Sivis in 4A 15 after Cole of House Sivis.
Fen of House Phiarlan took the headship of House Phiarlan in 4A 20.
Arn of House Jorasco, head of his house for a single year, died in 4A 24.
Alder of House Kundarak lived to old age and died in 4A 16.
In 4A 13, Ivo of House Cannith died of old age.
Isa of House Lyrandar died in the 23rd year of the Fourth Age.
Hild of House Kundarak passed away in 4A 24.
Bessa of House Silverhand still ruled House Silverhand in 4A 25.
Dorn of House Jorasco became head of House Jorasco in 4A 24.
In 4A 10, Hask of House Jorasco became head of House Jorasco.
Brak of House Jorasco succeeded Hask of House Jorasco in 4A 12.
Bryn of House Lyrandar became the head of House Lyrandar in 4A 10.
Ivor of House Orien succeeded Gareth of House Orien as head of House Orien in 4A 8.
The wards at Lux Oescus failed in 4A 2 with Ivor of House Sivis's caravan on the road.
Fera of House Medani became head of House Medani in 4A 3, after Lorn of House Medani died of illness.
Cara of Magnus' Rest married Alder of House Kundarak in 4A 10.
Hask of House Silverhand, head of House Silverhand, was slain by Bessa of House Silverhand in 4A 7.
Dorn of House Silverhand died of a wasting illness in 4A 7; Bessa of House Silverhand had poisoned him.
